No PS4 themes match these filters.

Use your own USB wallpaper

  1. Prepare the imageUse a JPG or PNG. The official guide supports up to 1920 × 1080 on PS4 or 3840 × 2160 on PS4 Pro. Place it inside an IMAGES folder at the root of a FAT32 or exFAT USB drive.
  2. Open the console’s image pickerInsert the drive, then open Settings > Themes > Select Theme > Custom > Select Image > USB Storage Device. Select and crop the picture.
  3. Apply the backgroundPreview the result and select Apply. The wallpaper route uses an image; a RAR archive or a theme PKG is a different file type.
  • PlayStation: official USB wallpaper instructions

Supplied PS4 PKG theme sources

PS4 PKG Themes folder

The user-supplied MEGA folder is preserved exactly. Its file list, package licenses and firmware requirements have not been verified, so no package in this folder is presented as a tested download.

Open supplied MEGA folder

PS2 Legacy Dynamic Theme reference

The supplied source links EP9000-CUSA07875_00-PSLEGACYTHEME001.pkg. MediaFire lists 12.88 MB. Distribution rights and activation requirements are unverified; use the source to check provenance before obtaining the package.

Open supplied theme source

PS4 extended storage cannot store themes according to PlayStation’s storage documentation. Use an ordinary supported USB drive for importing an image or staging a package, and apply or install it through the relevant console feature.
